g.text: Preciazo - Design-Level Event Storming: Shopping Planning
AV2 Design Proposal - US07-US12 and US18
Use date/time when name is omitted
Increase quantity if product already exists
Requery after add / remove / reduce item
Calculated on query; not a persisted event
Define or change a positive limit
Buyer decides to close this list
Saved Template and Current Offer Selection
One available current price per product
Only eligible stores; preference is not a price change
Buyer selects a preference to remove
Templates copy requirements only, never historical prices or purchase flags.
Clones are new ACTIVE lists; unavailable/stale required quotes create no partial list.
Completed lists are read-only; retries/no-op preferences emit no duplicate events.
Budget warning remains a query calculation; unmarking reduces checkout total.
Trusted store/current-price provisioning and quote freshness require agreement.
Preferred-store presentation must preserve the independent US13 price ranking.
Favorite delivery to Catalog and accepted-substitute application remain pending.
No ACL, automatic shopping recurrence or cross-context subscription is introduced.
